logic_errors.reason: Frame timeout immediately enters unconditional worker.join during cleanup; GPU initialization/readback/shutdown hang can freeze pygame indefinitely.
std::_Exit(4) now terminates the entire host process instead of only the diagnostic viewer.
Frozen spec bundles only armada_viewer, omitting the required embedded shared library.
C ABI lacks single-flight/close-versus-frame lifetime protection; concurrent callers may race pixel copy or access deleted state.

suggestions: Dispose native handle even if embedded worker exited
summary: Independent review rejected current original-window architecture; checkpoint only, do not merge.
